ideas.pitch: A web-based toolkit that automates heuristic evaluations and user journey friction analysis for UI/UX case studies.
ideas.problem_statement: Round 1 Online Case Study Submission requiring research-driven design projects, heuristic evaluations, and critique of design flaws.
ideas.title: CaseCraft UI: Interactive Design Critique & Heuristic Testing Suite
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the judging rubric of Round 1 case study requirements by providing structured, data-backed research findings and heuristic scores that judges can interact with live.

ideas.pitch: An accessibility testing overlay that evaluates contrast, touch target sizes, and screen-reader flows in real time.
ideas.problem_statement: Creating designs that are functional, inclusive, and impactful, balancing creativity with functionality and inclusivity.
ideas.title: AccessFlow: Inclusive Design Auditor for Mobile Interfaces
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses the explicit requirement for inclusivity and accessibility, proving through live metrics that the interface is usable for individuals with diverse physical needs.

ideas.pitch: A design workspace tool that aggregates survey inputs into live, interactive user personas with dynamic journey maps.
ideas.problem_statement: Creating user personas and conducting research-driven design projects for realistic, case-driven environments.
ideas.title: PersonaPulse: Real-Time Dynamic User Persona Generator for Case Studies
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates rigorous upfront UX research methodology which is heavily prized by design club organizers in time-bound hackathon rounds.

ideas.pitch: A rapid prototyping tool designed specifically to help teams adapt to surprise constraints and sudden design brief pivots.
ideas.problem_statement: Participants ready to take on surprise challenges and constraints, adapting flexibly while maintaining design quality.
ideas.title: TwistUI: Dynamic Constraint-Driven Design Prototyper
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly solves the specific hackathon challenge of pivoting under pressure when organizers drop unexpected twists during the event.

ideas.pitch: A companion tool for UI designers to record, analyze, and benchmark micro-interaction latency and cognitive load across screens.
ideas.problem_statement: Delivering seamless, intuitive, and thoughtful user journeys under time-bound hackathon rounds.
ideas.title: FlowTrace: Micro-Interaction UX Journey Debugger
ideas.why_it_could_win: Shifts the judging focus from static mockups to deeply analyzed motion and micro-interactions, standing out visually and functionally against standard slide presentations.
